'''Daniel J. Edwards''' is an American actor who worked on the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} from [[Pokémon the Series: XY]] to [[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]. He is currently affiliated with Stewart Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Edwards was born on June 21, 1988. As an adult, he became a voice actor and was involved with a number of English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series. Edwards joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, but his best-known role was as [[Aether Foundation]] Branch Chief {{an|Faba}} during {{aniseries|SM}}.
